name: A_VALIDATE_FLOW
description: Deterministic compose-to-execute check: verifies every block name exists in the installed catalog, required inputs are satisfiable, and sovereignty annotations exist on every step. Pure static checks - never executes blocks. Loads the catalog from the installed blocks directory (trust root), never from pipeline input. Returns validation { valid, findings, annotations }; the execution wiring (P-805) is responsible for refusing to run flows where valid is false.
